scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 functional with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable friction; 10 exceptional within the observed scope. Holistic judgment, not a win/loss grade or arithmetic average.

reasons.overall_mobile: A coherent complete mission with useful mobile navigation and recovery assistance, satisfying visible milestones and strong atmosphere. Manual combat precision and small-screen information density remain material friction. Two assisted wins do not prove broad mobile polish.
reasons.controls: MOVE visibly moved forward and strafed; AIM, FIRE, DASH and TURN responded. Precise manual aiming was only briefly sampled and often hit cover. Assistance did most navigation; sustained free-look/manual combat mastery is unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, coil windows and uplink formed distinct understandable phases. DASH armor opening and coil OFF feedback were helpful. Route-led traversal offered limited evidence of deeper tactical challenge or sustained enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Consistent cyan/amber visual language, atmospheric rain, wet surfaces, stylized architecture and polished title/end layouts. Audio and real-device smoothness unassessed.
reasons.usability: Clear objective transitions, hold-to-recover, paused map, visible fresh-start and useful threat-facing control. Many simultaneous HUD panels and changing hold labels required attention.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo, objective and end stats clear at 844x390. Small signs, typewriter-style announcements, handbook overflow and dark enemy silhouettes reduced quick scene reading.

unassessed: Hardware performance, frame rate and thermal/battery behavior
Continuous uninterrupted enjoyment or human reaction time
Recovered-memory prose beyond names/roles on end screen
Sustained manual look, fine-aim accuracy and sensitivity tuning
